# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Store clerk and sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Rufus was a tall, slim, handsome man with a high cheek color and pale hair. He shared identical facial features with his double cousin Laurence Vane, including a distinct hereditary eye quirk where one eye was blue and the other was hazel.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Rufus was a bully from birth who possessed a small, wicked soul. He continuously desired things until he obtained them, after which he lost interest. Though he could be pleasant and amiable when matters went smoothly, he was heavy-drinking, selfish, persistent, and possessed a wild, nautical inclination.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046)_

## Goals

- To marry Lorna Ainslie by any means necessary  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane became smitten with Lorna Ainslie, but she repeatedly rejected him. To force her into marriage, he threatened her mother, Rose Ainslie, with foreclosing the mortgage on the Ainslie farm, which was held by his father Abner Vane. Desperate to keep her home, Rose pressured seventeen-year-old Lorna into marrying him. Following their wedding, they lived on the Ainslie farm through the winter. By spring, Rufus grew tired of domestic life and left for Nova Scotia, where he joined his cousin Laurence Vane aboard the ship Four Sisters bound for Havana, Cuba. While in Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever and died approximately thirteen years before the truth was uncovered. For twelve years, the people of Seven Gulls mistaken his surviving cousin Laurence—who had lost his memory from a severe head injury—for Rufus, until a successful brain surgery in Montreal restored Laurence's memory and revealed Rufus's true fate.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)_
